policy: Official-source access decisions only. UNKNOWN remains in place when the default visitor experience is not clear.

records.name: Westminster Hall
records.rationale: Westminster Hall is included in scheduled Palace of Westminster ticketed tours.

records.name: St Bartholomew's North Wing
records.rationale: Official visit page publishes recurring public opening days; guided tours can be booked separately.

records.name: Kenwood House
records.rationale: House has published daily hours; advance booking is optional and admission is free.

records.name: Syon House
records.rationale: House and gardens operate a seasonal timetable with paid admission and bookable tours.

records.name: Wilton's Music Hall
records.rationale: Interior access is tied to scheduled performances and bookable heritage tours.

records.name: Ham House and Garden
records.rationale: Official page publishes asset-specific hours and states that general admission is not pre-booked.

records.name: Severndroog Castle
records.rationale: General admission is available on published Sunday opening sessions without advance booking.

records.name: Boston Manor House
records.rationale: Official visit page confirms public opening times; standard house access is treated as scheduled public entry.

records.name: London Scottish House
records.rationale: Official museum page explicitly states that visits are by appointment only and lists paid group tours.

records.name: Palace of Westminster
records.rationale: Visitor access is through dated audio, guided or specialist tour tickets.

records.name: Tower Bridge
records.rationale: Interior exhibition access has published opening hours and ticket checks.

records.name: Royal Albert Hall
records.rationale: Visitor access to the interior is through scheduled paid tours or performances.

records.name: Buckingham Palace
records.rationale: The State Rooms open seasonally and entry is by dated ticket.

records.name: Hampton Court Palace
records.rationale: Palace access follows published daily hours and requires admission; advance purchase is recommended but on-day tickets may be available.

records.name: Woolwich Town Hall
records.rationale: The building operates as civic and registration premises rather than a general visitor attraction; the planner default is an exterior stop.

records.name: Fulham Palace
records.rationale: Official visitor information provides regular public opening and free standard admission.

records.name: Apothecaries' Hall
records.rationale: The official site routes hall tours through enquiries and otherwise presents the building as a working and hire venue.

records.name: Ironmongers' Hall
records.rationale: The Hall is a working livery and events venue; visits require prior arrangement.

records.name: National Trust - Sutton House and Breaker's Yard
records.rationale: Official page provides recurring opening sessions; self-led admission can be bought at the door while tours are bookable.

records.name: Vanbrugh Castle
records.rationale: It is a private listed residence; local official heritage guidance identifies street viewing as the public experience.

records.name: Royal Courts of Justice
records.rationale: HMCTS publishes weekday public opening hours; public hearings may be observed subject to security and court restrictions.

records.name: Valentines Mansion & Gardens
records.rationale: Public interior access is driven by advertised open days, exhibitions, tours and events rather than daily general admission.

records.name: Hall Place & Gardens
records.rationale: The official venue publishes general opening times; some attractions and tours have separate tickets.

records.name: Carshalton Water Tower & Historic Garden Trust
records.rationale: Official page describes volunteer-dependent Sunday openings from after Easter to September, plus occasional out-of-season events.

records.name: National Trust - Fenton House and Garden
records.rationale: Official page publishes limited weekly openings and a November-February closure; pre-booking is no longer used for standard visits.

records.name: Harrow School Chapel
records.rationale: The chapel is an active part of the private school; no regular general-public visitor access is published.

records.name: Forty Hall Estate
records.rationale: The estate operates as a public museum and park with published venue hours; the exact page should be rechecked during the next source refresh.

records.name: Strawberry Hill House & Garden
records.rationale: Official visitor page publishes opening times and recommends online booking for guaranteed entry and best price.

records.name: Trellick Tower
records.rationale: Reviewer confirmed the building identity and appointment-only interior access. The building remains viewable from public streets, but the supplied tower site blocks automated verification.

records.name: Michelin House
records.rationale: Historic England confirms the listed Michelin House facade; the planner default is an exterior architecture stop, while access to businesses inside is separate and optional.

records.name: Canonbury Tower
records.rationale: The official local guide operator advertises dated Canonbury Tower tours and directs visitors to book a place; no daily walk-in access is published.

records.name: Granada Bingo Hall
records.rationale: The former Granada operates as Buzz Bingo Tooting with published club hours. Entry is treated as customer access without advance booking; paid games and age or membership conditions remain separate.

records.name: The Ancient House
records.rationale: Historic England confirms the Grade II Ancient House at 2-8 Church Lane, Walthamstow. No regular public interior access is published, so the planner default is a free exterior stop.

records.name: Royal Opera House - Floral Hall
records.rationale: Royal Ballet and Opera visitor information confirms public building access, while the former Floral Hall, now Paul Hamlyn Hall, is available around performances and programmed activity.

records.name: Farm House
records.rationale: The reviewed identity is the private Tudor-revival house at 22 Farm Street within the Mayfair Conservation Area. The reliable visitor experience is viewing it from the public street.

records.name: Garnault Place
records.rationale: Reviewer confirmed that this record refers to the Garnault Place elevation of Finsbury Town Hall. Historic England confirms that elevation; the planner default is an exterior stop.

records.name: Queens ex cinema art deco
records.rationale: Westminster's conservation audit identifies the former Queen's Cinema at Bishops Bridge Road and its Art Deco frontage. The cinema use has ended, so the planner default is exterior viewing.

records.name: Central Hall Westminster
records.rationale: Central Hall's official listings publish dated public concerts, conferences and other events with event-specific booking rather than unrestricted sightseeing access.

records.name: Montcalm East
records.rationale: The official hotel site confirms the reviewed identity. Because this planner record focuses on the building rather than hotel services, the conservative default is a free exterior architecture stop.
